notes: Single pure-JS module with an exact export interface (plain function step on a cell-state object, module.exports = { step: step }, no imports/classes). Logic: 4-direction neighbour eligibility (bounds, blocked flag, object checks), min-cost selection with a fixed directional tie-break order, battery-exhaustion hold rule, and layered malformed-state fallbacks. Nonzero rubric for reasoning_depth (tie-break + cost rules), debugging_ambiguity (order-of-checks subtleties), adversarial_inputs/hidden_case_generalization (empty grid, out-of-bounds, null cells, missing fields, battery edge). No tool breadth, dependency chain, or resource pressure; totals bucket to medium.
